contentStandards: Include only sections relevant to the course and admission pathway.
Explain eligibility and applicable entrance examinations using official sources.
Verify application and counselling dates before publication.
Identify the academic year covered by each guide.
State the verification date for time-sensitive information.
Include relevant official resources and clarify that official notifications take precedence.
publishingChecklist: Verify eligibility and deadlines against official sources.
Include official source links and a verification date.
Identify fees, currency, and payment period where applicable.
Check PDF text, links, tables, accessibility, and page layout.
Verify the deployed website link before listing a document as published.
Clearly identify or remove outdated editions from active listings.

privacy.privateRecordsStorage: Use secure backend storage with appropriate authentication and authorization.
